english.title: With intent to deceive make / possess a CPC / other document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[made]_
(B)_[possessed]_

a document so closely resembling a document as referred to in regulation 11(2) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), providing evidence of a CPC, as to be calculated to deceive
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 13(1)(c) and (4) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.

english.notes:
(i) In England, Wales and Northern Ireland, "forges" means makes a false document in order that it may be used as genuine.
(ii) See regulation 13(5), (6), (7) and (8) for details in relation to the time limits on prosecutions.
(iii) See regulation 14 for the power to seize documents.
(iv) This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007. For the offence applying before this date, see H20127 (authority / qualification card / community licence / certificate) or H21546 (Swiss CPC / other document).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit on prosecutions:
Complex - see regulation 13 of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
